newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-THOMPSON SETS INDOOR RECORD IN 55 METERS DASH.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-THOMPSON SETS INDOOR RECORD IN 55 METERS DASH.

text.p: Obadele Thompson of Barbados set a world indoor record in the 55 meters dash by clocking 5.99 seconds at the Western Athletic Conference championships on Saturday.
Thompson, a student at University of Texas-El Paso, was one-hundredth of a second faster than the previous mark of 6.00 set by American Lee McRae in 1986.
The 20-year-old Thompson competed for Barbados in the Atlanta Olympics, finishing fourth in the 200 meters.
